creators.name: Rayvel Holographics
creators.description: Rayvel ribbon cutting ceremony and dedication. Company focused on holographic technology for security, science, industry, and immersive visual experiences.

creators.name: HoloCenter NYC

creators.name: HiHolography (Hellenic Institute of Holography)

creators.name: Virtual Museum of Holography
creators.description: HoloSeminar series — 'What is a Hologram?' panel discussions with holographic artists.

creators.name: Holography at BYU
creators.description: Holographic video monitor demos, rainbow holograms, stereogram GUI, color balance demos.

creators.name: Imaging and Displays Research Group (De Montfort University)

creators.description: Holographic data visualization, capturing laser transmission holograms, Blythtype cyanotype. Associated with Martin Richardson's research group at DMU.

creators.name: singlemode (HoloTalk)

creators.name: LitiHolo

creators.name: River Valley Technologies
creators.description: Primarily a publishing/technology company channel, but contains holography-specific content including 'Fine Art Holography in Transition — Analogue to Digital', 'Holography in the history of Contemporary Art', 'Installation with Sunlight and Holography', ISDH symposium recordings.

creators.name: Jacques Holograms
creators.description: Synthetic holography — 'The Perspectives of Synthetic Holography', 'Experiments in composition for synthetic holography', 'Content Metamorphosis in Synthetic Holography', 'GraphisHologram', 'Tractatus Holographis'.

creators.name: Applied Science
creators.description: General science/engineering channel with occasional holography content, notably 'Holograms on chocolate'.

creators.name: Getty Museum
creators.description: Art museum channel. Relevant for the Getty holography exhibition documentation featuring Matthew Schreiber's work.

creators.name: OTA Contemporary (Santa Fe gallery)
creators.description: Gallery channel featuring August Muth exhibitions. 'August Muth Holograms at OTA Contemporary', 'Message from Hologram Artist, August Muth', 'Please Stand By by August Muth'.

creators.name: Martin Richardson
creators.description: PhD in Display Holography (Royal College of Art, 1988). Holographic art including David Bowie hologram portrait, 'The Invisible Engineering of Holographic Illusion' (5.5 min lecture), 'The Crystal Skull Hologram', 'The Science and Art of Holograms' (30 min lecture), holographic capture systems, and multiple holographic art pieces.

creators.name: HoloCenter (Vimeo)
creators.description: Exhibition documentation from HoloCenter on Governors Island, NYC. Features works by Sam Moree, Geo Stadnik, Maximus Clarke, Nic Koller, Valeria Divinorum, Emma Hendry, Evan Voelbel, Ed Bear, Rita Jimenez, Shohei Katayama, Nooshin Rostami, Emily Allyn Andersen, Kamari Carter & Julian Day, Ioana Pioaru.

creators.name: Al Razutis — Visual Alchemy
creators.description: Al Razutis has documented decades of holographic art through his Visual Alchemy archive. Site includes hologram sales and lease pages, the Sharon McCormack Collection & Archives, and historical documentation of West Coast holographic artists. Comprehensive record of the American holographic art movement.

creators.name: Jason Sapan / Holographic Studios NYC
creators.description: Holographic Studios NYC — 45+ years of continuous operation, making it one of the longest-running holography studios in the world. Founded by Jason Sapan (TheDrlaser). Offers gallery viewing, hands-on classes, studio tours, and custom portrait commissions. Now with locations in NYC and Hawaii. The website documents decades of holographic portraiture and art collaborations.

creators.name: Jonathan Ross — Hologram Collection
creators.description: One of the world's largest private holography collections, built over 30+ years. Features works by John Kaufman, Inaki Beguiristain, Mike Medora, Hans Bjelkhagen, Yves Gentet, Ruben Nunez, and James Turrell. Gallery 286 in London hosted 18 holography exhibitions before closing in March 2026. The collection continues online via jrholocollection.com.

creators.name: Martin Richardson (website)
creators.description: Martin Richardson holds a PhD in Display Holography from the Royal College of Art (1988). Author of 'Space Bomb' and '2D 3D 4D'. His holographic artwork includes the iconic David Bowie portrait and experimental narrative holography. Links to his Vimeo channel with 15 holographic art works.

creators.name: Eric Leiser (website)
creators.description: Holographic filmmaker and visual artist. Filmography spans holographic sculpture, animated films, and music videos. Work included in Whitney Museum exhibitions. Kinoscope releases distribute his experimental holographic cinema. Multiple YouTube channels document his creative process and exhibition installations.

creators.name: LaserboyHolo (website)
creators.description: Travis (LaserboyHolo) creates handmade dichromated gelatin (DCG) holography, combining scientific precision with artistic craft. Portfolio includes jewelry, glasswork, and experimental holograms. Online store sells holographic pendants and art pieces. Active on YouTube, Instagram, and Twitter with behind-the-scenes process content.

creators.name: Joshua Dellay (website)
creators.description: Josh Dellay's personal site covering holography, optics, and laser experimentation. Features newsletter with updates on hologram projects including Escher's Cubic Sphere, Geola pulse laser work, and hologram jewelry. Direct links to his active YouTube channel (@JoshuaDellay) with 23 holography-focused videos.

creators.name: Matthew Schreiber (website)
creators.description: Matthew Schreiber is a holographic artist and exhibition technician. His work was featured in the Getty Center's 'Sculpting with Light: Contemporary Artists and Holography' exhibition (2026). Website documents his laboratory work, portfolio, CV, and archival projects spanning large-format holography and installation art.

creators.name: Rob Hocking (website)
creators.description: Mathematician and holographer exploring the intersection of digital holography, fractal art, and 3D visualization. Work includes black hole holographic visualization and mathematically-inspired holographic art. Links to his YouTube channel (@RobHockingMathArt) documenting digital holography techniques for artists.

creators.name: Ed Wesly Studio
creators.description: Ed Wesly — ISDH 2024 organizer and holography educator. Website hosts pedagogy materials including 'Seven Single Beam Projects' and detailed technical guides for holography beginners. ISDH presentation pages document his contributions to display holography education and conference organization.

creators.name: HoloCenter NYC (website)
creators.description: Center for the Holographic Arts — the primary institution supporting holographic artists in the US. Founded by Martina Mrongovius. Offers exhibitions, workshops, artist residencies, and community events. Currently located at 518 Broadway, Kingston, NY. Has hosted exhibitions including 'The Possibility of Something Else' and numerous artist showcases on Governors Island.

creators.name: Holography Forum
creators.description: The primary online community for display holography since 1998. Over 51,000 posts across 6,500+ topics covering DCG emulsions, silver halide processing, optics, laser sources, gallery exhibitions, and technique troubleshooting. Active community of practicing holographers, researchers, and collectors worldwide.

creators.name: Global Images Hologram Art Collection
creators.description: Walter Clarke's curated collection of 34 artists and 89 holograms. Features individual artist pages for Rudi Berkhout, Adrian Lines, Mark Diamond, Dominic Manthorpe, and others. Documents the golden era of art holography from the 1980s-2000s with high-quality reference imagery.

creators.name: Hellenic Institute of Holography (website)
creators.description: The Hellenic Institute of Holography has promoted holography since 1987. Creators of OptoClones — high-quality display holograms. Organized LightAlive conferences in Shanghai (2019), Moscow (2016), and St. Petersburg (2015). Links to YouTube channel (@HiHolography) with 101 videos documenting conferences and holographic techniques.

creators.name: LitiHolo (website)
creators.description: LitiHolo manufactures hologram kits, the 3D hologram printer, and supplies for hobbyists and educators. Website offers educational content on making holograms, product documentation, and a gallery of user-created holograms. Commercial hub for accessible, consumer-level holography.

creators.name: ISDH 2026
creators.description: International Symposium on Display Holography 2026 — the premier gathering for display holography. Held at Lake Forest College, June 21-27, 2026. Features presentations, demonstrations, exhibitions, and a field trip to Holo Inc. in Chicago. Registration, schedule, and presenter information available.

creators.name: Jiwon Choi
creators.description: PhD student in Optical Sciences at the University of Arizona, working with Dr. Weimin Zhou in Computational Imaging and Visualization. Research focuses on computational holography and display technologies. Emerging researcher in the CGH and digital holography space.
